blocks.text: Rosalind Franklin aur Maurice Wilkins ne DNA ki molecular structure (X-ray ke zariye) ka mutala kiya. James D. Watson aur Francis Crick ne 1953 mein DNA ka model pesh kiya. Chargaff ke mushahidaat (observations) bhi DNA ki structure maloom karne mein bunyadi ahmiyat rakhte thay. Watson aur Crick ke DNA model ke ahem nukaat yeh hain:

1950 mein Linus Pauling ne nateeja nikala ke DNA reshedar (fibrous) maadda hai aur yeh resha helix (kundli) mein lipta hua hai. 1951 mein Erwin Chargaff ne aham data diya jis se pata chala ke DNA mein adenine aur thymine barabar miqdar mein hain, aur guanine aur cytosine bhi barabar.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein Franklin ke naam ke saath 1953 aur Wilkins ke naam ke saath 1967 likha hai. Wilkins ne DNA par X-ray ka kaam 1950 se 1953 ke darmiyan Franklin ke saath kiya tha, aur 1962 mein Watson aur Crick ke saath Nobel Prize hasil kiya; 1967 is kaam ka saal nahin.

items: DNA do polynucleotide chains (strands) se bana hai.
Dono strands ek doosre ke gird lipat kar double helix banate hain.
Double helix seerhi (ladder) jaisa hai. Is ke do khambe (poles) sugars aur phosphate groups se bane hain, aur is ke dande (rungs) nitrogenous bases ke joron (base pairs) se.
Har base pair (danda) ek purine (A ya G) aur ek pyrimidine (C ya T) se banta hai.
Dono strands apne bases ke darmiyan kamzor hydrogen bonds se jure rehte hain.
Ek strand ka adenine doosre strand ke thymine se hydrogen bonds banata hai (ya ulat). Ek strand ka guanine doosre strand ke cytosine se hydrogen bonds banata hai (ya ulat).
A aur T ke jore mein do hydrogen bonds aur G aur C ke jore mein teen hydrogen bonds hote hain.
Dono strands phosphodiester linkages ke lihaz se ek hi simt mein nahin chalte, balke ek doosre ke ulat (anti-parallel) chalte hain.

blocks.alt: (a) Double helix 2 nm chaura; base pairs dono strands ko jorte hain; ek poora chakkar 3.4 nm aur base pairs ka faasla 0.34 nm; minor aur major grooves. (b) Sugars aur phosphates (P) ke do mukhalif-rukh (antiparallel) strands, bases ke jore C-G, A-T, C-G, G-C dashed hydrogen bonds se jure (A-T do, G-C teen). Har strand 5' phosphate se shuru aur 3' sugar par khatm hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.44: (a) Watson aur Crick ka DNA model, (b) DNA ki tafseeli banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.44 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (b) mein baayan strand upar 5' (phosphate) se neeche 3' tak chalta hai, aur daayan strand ulta: neeche 5' se upar 3' tak; isi ko antiparallel kehte hain. Har strand ke 5' sire par azaad phosphate aur 3' sire par sugar ka azaad OH hai. A-T ke darmiyan do aur G-C ke darmiyan teen hydrogen bonds hain, isi liye G-C jora zyada mazboot hai.

DNA chromosomes ka bunyadi hissa hai, is liye eukaryotes mein yeh nucleus ke andar hota hai. Prokaryotes mein alag nucleus nahin hota, is liye un ka DNA cytoplasm mein hota hai. Viruses mein DNA beech mein (core molecule) hota hai aur us par protein ka ghilaf (coat) chadha hota hai.

blocks.title: Yaad karein
blocks.text: Eukaryotes mein DNA ki thori miqdar (taqreeban 2%) mitochondria aur chloroplasts mein bhi hoti hai.

DNA tamam jandaron ka hereditary material (wirasati maadda) hai (kuch viruses ke ilawa). DNA mein woh “program” hai jo aakhir kar cell ki saari activities ko chalata hai. DNA ka yeh program genes ki shakal mein hai. Gene DNA ke nucleotides ki woh sequence hai jo ek polypeptide banane ka code rakhti hai. Jab koi gene “ON” hota hai to DNA ke nucleotides ki sequence pehle RNA mein transcribe (copy) hoti hai aur phir khaas proteins mein translate hoti hai. Is tarah DNA cell ki khususiyaat aur activities control karta hai.
Bacterium E. coli ke chromosome mein DNA ke har strand mein taqreeban 50 lakh (5 million) bases ek khaas seedhi tarteeb mein hain. Is mein genes hain aur har gene kai sau bases ka hota hai.
